company.name: LegalZoom
company.shortDescription: LegalZoom is a technology platform giving access to professional legal advice so people can protect what matters most.
company.description:
LegalZoom is the nation's most recognized name in law, the alternative to the traditional law firm.  

The leading provider of online legal document services and legal plans to families and small businesses, LegalZoom offers high quality, affordable legal services, marrying cutting-edge technology with access to experienced attorneys. LegalZoom was founded on the idea that all Americans deserve access to the law;  and as of 2011 the company has helped close to two million small businesses and families with their legal needs.  Our high quality documents have been accepted in all 50 states, and 94% of customers would refer LegalZoom to their family and friends.

aiResearchSummary.text: LegalZoom is researching automated document analysis through a computer implemented method titled Automated document analysis. The abstract describes receiving a document, extracting text, and using an artificial intelligence engine to identify a document type from multiple document types. This work focuses on intelligent document categorization to support access to professional legal advice, highlighting research in AI driven text extraction and document type classification.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Equity round raised $700,000, or 0.07% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,000,000,000 to $2,000,000,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
